argv:
import hashlib, pathlib, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import drive_cli_rules as R
ws = '/ws'
rules = R.load_rules()
banner = 'Pane is dead (status 0, Sat Oct 17 13:26:00 2026)' + (' ' * 40)
old = 'Do you trust the files in this folder?\n' + ws + '\n[y/n] ' + ('\n' * 21)
dead = 'Do you trust the files in this folder?\n' + ws + '\n[y/n] y\ntrusted and done\n' + ('\n' * 18) + banner
r = R.classify_window(dead, ws, old, rules)
assert r['decision'] == 'wait' and r['answer'] is None and r['exit_code'] is None, r
fresh = R.match_pane(dead, ws, rules)
assert fresh['decision'] == 'stop' and fresh['category'] == 'unknown_prompt' and fresh['exit_code'] == 3 and fresh['answer'] is None, fresh
push = 'Do you trust the files in this folder?\n' + ws + '\n[y/n] y\nAllow git push origin main? [y/n]\n' + banner
p = R.classify_window(push, ws, old, rules)
assert p['decision'] == 'stop' and p['exit_code'] == 3 and p['answer'] is None and p['rule_id'] == 'push_network_install', p
sneak = R.match_pane('Pane is dead (status 0, not-a-date) Allow git push origin main? [y/n]', ws, rules)
assert sneak['decision'] == 'stop' and sneak['rule_id'] == 'push_network_install', sneak
plain = R.match_pane('Allow git push origin main? [y/n]\n' + banner, ws, rules)
assert plain['rule_id'] == 'push_network_install' and plain['answer'] is None, plain
pure = R.match_pane('Do you trust the files in this folder?\n' + ws + '\n[y/n] \n' + ('\n' * 20) + banner, ws, rules)
assert pure['decision'] == 'answer' and pure['rule_id'] == 'folder_trust' and pure['answer'] == 'y\n', pure
only = R.match_pane(banner + ('\n' * 20), ws, rules)
assert only['decision'] == 'wait' and only['answer'] is None and only['exit_code'] is None, only
assert R.normalize_pane('keep\n\n \n') == 'keep'
assert R.normalize_pane('[y/n] ') == '[y/n] '
assert R.normalize_pane('Pane is dead (status 130, Mon Jan  2 03:04:05 2026)\nkeep') == 'keep'
assert 'trusted and done' in R.normalize_pane(dead) and 'Pane is dead' not in R.normalize_pane(dead)
assert R.pane_digest(old) == hashlib.sha256(old.encode()).hexdigest()
scrolled = R.classify_window('Allow git push origin main? [y/n]\n' + 'Do you trust this folder /ws [y/n]', '/ws', 'Do you trust this folder /ws [y/n]', rules)
assert scrolled['decision'] == 'stop' and scrolled['exit_code'] == 3 and scrolled['answer'] is None, scrolled
sh = pathlib.Path('tests/test-drive-cli.sh').read_text()
for needle in ('npm install', 'git clean -fdX', 'git push origin main', 'API credits', 'sentinel'):
    assert needle in sh, needle
print('ok')
